Interface StatefulFOPRunnable

  • All Superinterfaces:
    FOPRunnable, StatefulRunnable

    public interface StatefulFOPRunnable
extends FOPRunnable, StatefulRunnable
    If a JFOP implements this interface, the same instance is always used for each call in the same context (the same GUI screen, for example).
